influences.name: Stereolab
influences.context: We worked with an engineer called Andy Ramsay. He was the drummer in Stereolab, who had quite a big influence on our music.

influences.name: Dilip Harris
influences.context: A good friend Dilip Harris mixed the record. The last two records he's really helped shape, and this is such an important part because despite doing this for a decade, there's a lot that he knows that we don't know about.

influences.name: James Blake
influences.context: Dom's understanding of Blake's vocals comes through six years of working together, including previous Kimbie tracks 'We Go Home Together' and 'How We Got By', as well as the many hours Dom has spent producing Blake's last two albums

influences.name: King Krule
influences.context: He also inspires us in the way he writes songs.

influences.name: Sonic Youth
influences.context: There's a track called "Rena" by Sonic Youth that I heard more than a decade ago that's always been in the back of my head: One day, I'm going to try and rip that off.

influences.name: Land of Talk
influences.context: There's a band called Land of Talk that has this super flat, compressed guitar sound that just sparked something in my head.

influences.name: NRBQ
influences.context: And then more jam band, almost comical American guitar music, like NRBQ. All of these things just sit around in the soup in your brain until you find a way to articulate them yourself.

influences.name: Roald Dahl
influences.context: Some of my favorite writing that I've ever read is by Roald Dahl. A lot of his adult writing is brilliant because each story just casts a spell on you and takes you to a completely different place. With this album, I wanted to really tap into my love of short stories and writing that's very much fiction.

influences.name: Pixies
influences.context: I read about how the Pixies wrote "Where is My Mind?" — I was like, where are these f—ing insane lyrics from? — and he's like, "Oh, I was snorkeling in the Bahamas and I was just writing about a fish that I saw." The idea of just letting go of trying to write about something was really, really good for me.
